title: What If You Never Slept Again? Day by Day
subject: sleepless man

scenes.text: What if you never slept again? The first night is the easy part.
After 24 hours awake, your judgment drops to about the level of a 0.10 percent blood alcohol.
By 48 hours, some people see things that are not there, from a smaller room to imaginary people.
At 72 hours, your brain forces microsleeps of one to 30 seconds, and you never notice them.
After four days, delusions and imagined sounds can set in, a state close to psychosis.
Teenager Randy Gardner stayed awake 264 hours in 1963. Never sleeping at all happens only in a rare, fatal disease.

description:
What if you never slept again?
By day four, the brain can slip into a state close to psychosis. The longest official record is 264 hours.
How long could you stay awake?
first_comment: What is the longest you have ever stayed awake? Drop your own 'what if' too.
